description: Content evals for release-acceptance. Run each with and without the skill; the with-skill transcript must meet every expect_with_skill item, judged against tool output in the transcript, not prose claims.

scenarios.name: seeded hint regression
scenarios.setup: Build the candidate from a commit that reverts one known 0.37 hint fix (update's --no-policy remediation hint). Catalogue: program journeys E01 and J07.
scenarios.prompt: Run release acceptance in full mode on <sha>, journeys E01 and J07 only.
expect_with_skill: the binary version is checked against the SHA before any journey runs
every step runs through scripts/capture.py in a world from scripts/world.py
the printed `--no-policy` hint is executed and its failure recorded
a finding with severity should-fix, a repro script, the SHA and an owner file:line
an independent verifier reproduces it with its own repro
a failing-before test brief for apm-lifecycle-tests
a release-gate row computed by scripts/findings.py gate-row
scenarios.expect_without_skill_gap: no hint execution, no independent verification, no gate row

scenarios.name: clean candidate, no false blocker
scenarios.setup: Current release-train tip with no known open blocker.
scenarios.prompt: Is <sha> ready to tag? Run the acceptance pass.
expect_with_skill: verdict GO, or NO-GO only with a blocker confirmed by the verifier
at most 1 blocker left unverified after P4
coverage summary with a probed ratio per journey
a human checkpoint before the row is published
scenarios.expect_without_skill_gap: unverified blocker claims, no coverage accounting

scenarios.name: recheck on a moved head
scenarios.setup: A findings.json with 10 findings recorded at an older SHA; a newer head where 6 are fixed, 3 still open, 1 changed. Hand-built oracle of the expected verdicts.
scenarios.prompt: The release PR moved to <new sha>. Re-check the open findings.
expect_with_skill: only the open findings are re-run, at the new SHA
the verdict table matches the oracle for all 10 findings
a new gate row at the new SHA
scenarios.expect_without_skill_gap: re-runs everything or nothing, verdicts not pinned to the SHA

scenarios.name: catalogue unavailable
scenarios.setup: A checkout without tests/lifecycle/journeys/index.yaml and no --catalog.
expect_with_skill: the pass stops and reports it; no embedded or invented journey list is used
